title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1969-10-24
lineage: Maxell XLIIS > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 tagged. September 2012
source: Source: AUD > ? > Cassette, kindly provided by Seaweed1010.

ai_review.summary: Stereo audience tape delivers clear, boomy Winterland sound and a rare Cryptical > Cosmic Charlie segue, but only about half the short one‑set show is captured.
ai_review.review: The new stereo AUD copy of 10/24/69 offers surprisingly good clarity for a '69 audience recording, with Tom Constanten’s keyboards sitting nicely in the mix and Jerry’s guitar going “utterly bananas” during an unforgettable Cryptical > Cosmic Charlie transition. The performance is average overall—solid jams like Easy Wind stand out—but the tape cuts off much of The Other One and only a fragment of the set survives, leaving listeners wishing for the missing half.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviewers note good sound quality and a unique jam, but also point out that only half the show is present and the overall performance is average; rating reflects mixed musical merit with decent recording.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo audience tape, clearer and more complete than earlier archive copy; boomy Winterland ambience, TC (Tom Constanten) prominent in mix, but missing large portions of the set and some tape drop‑outs.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short one‑set opener for Jefferson Airplane; only about half captured, making the set feel fragmented despite a few standout moments.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia solos heavily during the Cryptical > Cosmic Charlie segue, “hammering out” the intro with Hendrix‑style feedback.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s keyboards are up in the mix and join Pigpen and Garcia in a distinctive jam on Easy Wind.
